# What do you owe on this quarter's EU OSS return?

> Free EU VAT OSS calculator: EUR 10,000 threshold check and the quarterly OSS return by country and rate from a sales CSV.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it answers

An EU seller can charge its own country's VAT on digital services and distance sales of goods to consumers in other EU countries while those sales stay at or under EUR 10,000 a year (net of VAT, all countries together, this year and last). Above that, each sale takes the customer's country's rate, which the One-Stop-Shop reports on one quarterly return due by the end of the month after the quarter. Source: European Commission, VAT One Stop Shop guidance (Council Directive (EU) 2017/2455). As of 2026-11-14.
